name: Voltage Glitching
description: Injection of transient voltage perturbations into a target device's power supply to induce computational faults. Covers VCC glitching, crowbar glitching, body-biasing, glitch parameter optimization (width, offset, repeat), fault characterization, and exploitation of induced faults to bypass security checks or extract cryptographic keys via differential fault analysis.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to voltage fault injection techniques

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands voltage glitching principles and common fault models
evidence: Can explain how voltage glitches cause instruction skips and data corruption in CMOS logic
Understands glitch parameters (width, offset, voltage level) and their effects
Aware of common voltage glitch targets (secure boot checks, password verification, crypto operations)

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs voltage glitching on training targets using established setups under supervision
evidence: Configures ChipWhisperer glitch module parameters for a documented target
Performs VCC glitching to bypass a simple security check on a training board
Sweeps glitch parameters systematically and logs results
Identifies successful fault injection through target behavior analysis (crash, skip, corruption)

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently performs voltage glitching on real targets and exploits induced faults
evidence: Prepares target PCB for voltage glitching (decoupling capacitor removal, power rail isolation)
Optimizes glitch parameters for unfamiliar targets without documented setups
Bypasses secure boot or readout protection via voltage glitching on production devices
Performs differential fault analysis (DFA) using glitch-induced faulty ciphertexts
Completed voltage glitching assessments on 3+ different target platforms

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Attacks hardened targets; develops custom glitch setups; combines with other techniques
evidence: Defeats voltage glitch detectors and countermeasures on hardened targets
Develops custom glitch insertion circuits and triggering mechanisms
Combines voltage glitching with software exploitation for complex attack chains
Mentors junior analysts on PCB preparation, parameter optimization, and fault exploitation

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on voltage fault injection; publishes research; defines methodology
evidence: Published research on novel voltage glitching techniques or countermeasure evaluations
Defines the lab's voltage glitching methodology aligned with Common Criteria and EMVCo
Specifies and procures voltage glitch injection platforms for the lab's evaluation capability
Provides expert consultation on voltage glitch resistance to silicon designers

assessment_methods.description: Prepare a target for voltage glitching, optimize glitch parameters, and demonstrate a security bypass (e.g., secure boot bypass or readout protection defeat)
Observe PCB preparation technique, parameter sweep methodology, and fault characterization during a live glitching session

equipment: ChipWhisperer-Husky or ChipWhisperer-Pro with glitch module
